title: Solar AI ground PV research v1 (3-class clean)
subtitle: Leakage-clean YOLO ground-level PV defect dataset: panel / cracked / dusty
description:
Solar AI ground-level PV defect research dataset - FIRST EXPERIMENT build.

This is an audited, remediated, LEAKAGE-CLEAN repackaging of a publicly available Roboflow Universe dataset for RESEARCH / non-commercial use. Solar AI did NOT create the underlying photographs.

Source dataset:
  Susan. "panel solar Dataset." Roboflow Universe.
  https://universe.roboflow.com/susan-ifblr/panel-solar-bw945
  workspace/project/version: susan-ifblr / panel-solar-bw945 / 1  (YOLOv8 export)

License: CC BY 4.0, as displayed by the source on Roboflow. Attribution preserved. Image-level provenance of individual photographs is NOT independently verified.

Classes (contiguous, first experiment):
  0 = panel    (individual solar-panel boundary)
  1 = cracked  (crack / physical-damage region)
  2 = dusty    (dust / soiling region)

bird_drop is EXCLUDED from this experiment: the audit found it in only 9 images (~3 unique source photographs) - far too few to train or evaluate. This is a data-availability decision, not a product limitation. Hotspot is out of scope: RGB cannot validate thermal-hotspot semantics.

Remediation applied to the raw Roboflow export:
  - 614 YOLO-segmentation polygon annotations converted to bounding boxes
  - 1 exact byte-duplicate image (spanning train/test) removed -> 6,492 images
  - near-duplicate FAMILIES grouped before splitting (exact SHA-256 + source basename + 16x16 dHash); 537 families
  - leakage-clean split: whole families assigned to one split each; NO family spans train/valid/test (0 residual cross-split near-duplicate pairs). train 4,546 / valid 1,297 / test 649.

Layout: images/{train,valid,test}/ + labels/{train,valid,test}/ + data.yaml (Ultralytics). provenance/ carries the full audit report, remediation report, and per-image split manifests (every derived image -> source file, original official split, family id, sha256).

Intended use: training/evaluating a research-grade ground-level PV visual defect detector. Not a validated engineering or safety diagnosis. It does NOT replace an aerial PV panel detector.
